notes: §2002:A.1.2.3 GR4: data-name-1..4 hold queue and sub-queue names formed as system-names (hyphen and underscore, §2002:8.3.1.1) and defined to the MCS. The four-level structure PAY_Q/HOUR_LY/WEEK-1/DAY_2 gives ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT 00 000002 (§2002:A.2.1.3 GR1), an undefined sub-queue or queue gives 20 with the count unchanged (§2002:A.1.2.4 Table A.1), and RECEIVE returns M1. A --std 2002 run in a fresh directory matched the derived .out.
